name: Lake Del Valle SRA
description: Lake Del Valle State Recreation Area, south of Livermore, is part of the State Water Project and is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District as Del Valle Regional Park. It is popular for swimming, boating, fishing, camping, and horseback riding.
fullDescription: Lake Del Valle State Recreation Area, south of Livermore, is part of the State Water Project and is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District as Del Valle Regional Park. It is popular for swimming, boating, fishing, camping, and horseback riding.
whatTheyOffer:
- Swimming at East and West beaches, with lifeguards on duty in summer
- Boat launch, boat rentals, and fishing
- Tent, group, and RV camping with hookups
- Hiking, biking, and horseback riding trails, plus a visitor center and naturalist programs
howToGetIt: Operated by the East Bay Regional Park District. Vehicle day use is $5, or $10 on weekends and holidays from April through Labor Day. State park passes are not listed as accepted here. Check ebparks.org for camping reservations and current swim conditions, including any blue-green algae advisories.
